a2-unit-08.08.1 First day:
Jake: Hi, I'm Jake. I'm your guide this week. Welcome to Florida!
Ana: Thanks! I'm Ana, and this is my husband, Marcos. We're so excited.
Jake: Great. Safety is very important to us, so I need to ask you some questions first. Have you ever been kayaking?
Ana: Yes, I have. I've kayaked many times. My cousin Carol lives in Orlando, and last year we kayaked on a river near her house.
Jake: And you, Marcos?
Marcos: No, I've never been kayaking. But I can swim very well.
Jake: Good to know. On Tuesday we're going to Crystal River. Have you ever swum with manatees?
Marcos: Manatees? I've never even seen a manatee!
Jake: They're big, gentle sea animals. In winter, hundreds of them come to the warm springs there.
Ana: Wow! I saw one in a documentary, but I've never seen one in real life.
Jake: You'll love it. And on Thursday we have the zip line. Have you ever done a zip line?
Marcos: Yes, I have. I did one in the mountains in Brazil when I was twenty. I loved it!
Ana: I haven't. I'm a little afraid of heights.
Jake: That's OK. You can watch if you prefer. One last question. Have you ever camped?
Ana: Marcos has. I haven't. I prefer hotels!
Jake: Well, on Friday night we're camping in a state park. It's beautiful, I promise.
Ana: Camping? OK... We're on vacation. Let's try new things!
